Not another symptom checker.

Most health apps store what already happened. TwinCast is built around a different idea: your Digital Twin, reasoned over by Ontomorph's HOLON knowledge graph, can project what happens next — and explain why, in your own words, on your own body.

What's inside

Six ways to understand your body.

01
Digital Twin
A living anatomical map of your labs, medications, history, and vitals — organized the way your body actually is, not the way a spreadsheet is.
02
Predictive Simulation
Toggle a lifestyle change — quit smoking, lose weight, cut sugar, exercise — and watch your organs project forward 3, 6, or 12 months.
03
Twin AI Companion
Not a generic chatbot. Every answer is grounded in your actual data, reasoned over HOLON's medical knowledge graph.
04
Lab Interpreter
Every result mapped to the organ it affects, explained in plain English — no more guessing what an abbreviation means.
05
Medication Safety
Add a new prescription and get an instant interaction check — plus adherence tracking that feeds straight into your health score.
06
Doctor Access
One QR code opens a read-only clinical snapshot for any doctor, anywhere — no login, no waiting on records.
